provenance.encodes: Bates numbers in record cites (a producing party's prefix and a zero-padded page number, alone or as a range)
provenance.how_to_verify: Compare with the production-numbering conventions of a court's ESI order or the parties' protocol; Bluebook B17 covers record cites generally.

positive.text: The email is in the production. ABC0001234.
Compare ABC0001234-ABC0001240 with DEF-000123 – DEF-000130 and XYZ0012345-47.

negative: Filed through ESTTA1601608 on the opposition deadline.
The application was submitted as TEAS-1234567 by the applicant.
The board docket is at TTABVUE-91234567 for this proceeding.

note: dot-1ij4xz.10: Bates numbers, from the forms the dotfiles legal-citation-validator kept locally. Six to ten digits after an upper-case prefix (two to eight letters, optionally two words joined by - or _), an optional - or _, and an optional range to a full number or its last digits. Patent publication prefixes (`US7654321`) are rejected. lcr-lb7: USPTO filing ids (ESTTA, TEAS and TTABVUE prefixes) and any token after `Tracking number:` are rejected.
